live.offline: offline — changes wait to be sent

noAccess.title: You don't have access to requests
noAccess.body: Sales see and answer requests (Sales › Incoming). Ask your administrator for the sales role if you need them.

list.intro: New requests and RFQs from mail, the portal, the phone, a fair or a visit, until they become a quote. The oldest waiting first.
list.rulesLaterHint: Comes later: requests are given by hand for now
list.countCapped: The first {count} requests: narrow the filters to see the rest
list.noMatchBody: Change or clear the filters to see more requests.
list.emptyBody: No requests. A customer's portal request lands here by itself; a mail becomes one from Mail to sort ("Make incoming request"); a phone call or a visit with New request.

row.openNewTab: Open full page in a new tab

keys.quote: Make quote (the focused or selected request, or the open one)

notice.label: Notices

notice.mail_one: {count} mail waits in Mail to sort

refusal.CLOSED: {number} is closed: only its note can change
refusal.NOT_WAITING: {number} does not wait for the customer
refusal.NEEDS_CUSTOMER: {number} is from a prospect: match it to a customer first (Request) — a quote is made for a customer
refusal.OTHER_NEEDS_WORDS: Say in words why it is declined (the reason is Other)
refusal.MAIL_TAKEN: This mail was already made into {number}
refusal.QUOTE_TAKEN: This quote was already made from another request
refusal.MAIL_NOT_WAITING: Only a mail that was read (in Mail to sort, or in a thread) becomes a request
refusal.READ_ONLY: Your role reads requests; sales answers them
refusal.NO_LINES: {number} names nothing to make yet: add its lines (style, colourway, sizes) first
refusal.LINES_NOT_READY: {number} has lines that are not ready to order: each needs a style, its colourway and pieces by size (make the style draft first)
refusal.STYLE_DRAFTS_FULL: {number} already names the most style drafts one request holds
refusal.PROSPECT_ERASED: The prospect of {number} was erased: match it to a customer instead
refusal.CONFIRM_MATCH: Check that {number} is from this customer, then confirm the match

refusal.CODE_TAKEN: This code is already another party's: choose another

problem.unavailable: The factory cannot be reached right now. Try again in a moment.
problem.notFound: It is not there any more (or not in this company)
problem.signedOut: You were signed out: sign in again
problem.contract: The factory answered in a way this page does not read: reload the page
problem.rateLimited: Too many requests at once: wait a moment and try again
problem.stale: Someone changed it a moment ago: it was read again — check and try again
problem.staleSome: Some of these requests changed a moment ago: the list was read again — select them and try again
problem.invalid: Something typed does not fit: see the fields named below

record.notFoundBody: This request is not there any more, or it belongs to another company or customer you do not see.
record.offline: Offline — the request as last read; Apply and every verb wait for the connection
record.stale: Someone changed this request at {time}: reload to see it (your typing is kept until then)

done.messageSent: The message was sent to {to} (in Activity)
done.messageFailed: The message was not sent: write it again in Activity
done.quote: {quote} made from {number} as a draft: the customer is not told yet (they read “Quote being prepared”)

done.askInfoMail: Asked {customer} by e-mail: {number} waits for their answer (Need info); it resumes when they answer
done.orderCredit: {order} made from {number}: it waits for approval — the customer is over its credit limit or on a credit hold
done.orderApproval: {order} made from {number}: it waits for approval — an approval rule for orders asks for a yes first
done.filesCarried_one: {count} file of the request went with it
done.filesCarried_other: {count} files of the request went with it
done.styleDraft: Style draft {style} made from {number}; the request stays open

closed.noteOnly: A closed request changes no more: only its note.

who.title: Who asks
who.erased: Erased prospect (their personal data was removed)
who.unknown: Unknown sender — match to a customer

who.matchHint: Once matched, the customer stays: the mail joins its conversation
who.newHint: Not a customer yet: a prospect

problem.phone: A phone number: digits, spaces and ( ) . / -, an optional + first

basis.CONTRACT: Steps at their request (a request for a quote)

request.requestHint: As they said it; the lines below are the same request, structured
request.targetHint: The price the customer named; a price, shown only with the price right

request.noteHint: For us only; it can change even once the request is closed

problem.request: Say what they ask, in words
problem.price: The target price does not read as an amount (12,50 or 12.50)

line.pickStyle: Pick a style, or describe it in words
line.inWords: Not a style of ours: in words
line.colourTextHint: As the customer said it ("dark navy")
line.descriptionHint: A product we do not have as a style yet: say it in words

line.quantityHint: When the sizes are not known yet

line.styleFailed: Couldn't read this style's sizes and colourways

problem.sizes: The sizes do not read: size:pieces, e.g. 50:5 52:10

mail.title: The sender's mail, as sent
mail.subject: Subject
mail.waits: A prospect’s mail waits in Mail to sort until the request is matched to a customer; then it joins the conversation.

pack.title: The brand's tech pack
pack.hint: Carried to the quote and the order: always the version in force
pack.version: Tech pack version (as the brand names it)

pack.newer: Version {named} named; version {current} is in force now
pack.gone: No version of this file is available now
pack.choose: Files of the request and its mail
pack.chooseHint: Tick the files that are the tech pack; Apply keeps the choice

problem.type: This kind of file cannot be added

quote.noneProspect: A quote is made for a customer: match the prospect to a customer on Request first.
quote.noRight: Your role does not read quotes

quote.promiseHint: The target date, when it is ahead
quote.copiedLabel: Lines that go to the quote
quote.emptyDraft: No line names a style in a colourway with sizes: the quote starts empty (a draft to fill in).

leftOut.noColourway: Line {n}: no colourway picked — add it on the quote
leftOut.noSizes: Line {n}: no pieces by size — add the sizes on the quote

action.matchHint: Pick or make the customer; then replies are possible

order.title: Make order
order.promiseHint: The wanted date while it is ahead; change it if needed
order.customerRefHint: Required when the customer's terms ask for one
order.priceHint: Blank: the customer's list price. A price the customer was shown is filled in.
